input: hi! im hosting my whole extended family for christmas day lunch at my house in ikeja, lagos, about 60 people. i need 20 whole chickens (around 3 portions each) for jollof, stew and fried chicken, each one at least 1.8kg. i want proper fresh chicken like we always do every christmas, not cold-room chicken that has been sitting in freezer for weeks, the kind you can check with your own eyes that its good. it must reach my house latest the morning of 24 december and total has to be under ₦550,000. can you place the order for me pls

experiences.name: Surulere Party Pots Jollof & Fried Rice Trays
experiences.description: Big party pots of smoky jollof and fried rice for 60 guests, cooked with a vegetable stock base, fresh peppers, carrots, green beans and bay leaf. No meat included, so you can serve it with your own proteins. Cooked in Surulere on 24 December and delivered to Ikeja in foil coolers by 11 am, with serving spoons.

experiences.name: Mama Tolu Christmas Birds – Live Broilers
experiences.description: Christmas birds the familiar way: 20 live broilers, 1.8–2.3 kg each, brought to your door for your household to dress. Birds are transported live from Ogun State farms to our Lagos market pen, held there up to 48 hours, then delivered alive in woven baskets between 22 and 24 December for slaughter at your home. Each bird is weighed in front of you on arrival. Our van serves Ikeja, Ogba and Magodo; cash or transfer on delivery.

experiences.name: Ijebu Hills Farm-Dressed Native Chicken
experiences.description: Farm-raised native chicken for a proper Christmas stew: 20 whole local-breed birds of 1.8 kg and above, raised on our farm near Ijebu-Ode, Ogun State. Chickens are slaughtered and dressed by trained staff in the farm's on-site processing room and are not transported live off the farm or to your home. Processed 23 December, never frozen, and delivered chilled in cool boxes with ice packs by the farm's own van, reaching Ikeja by 9 am on 24 December.

experiences.name: Chops & Bites Small Chops Platter for 60
experiences.description: A full small chops spread for 60: golden puff-puff, sweet dodo, crisp vegetable spring rolls and spicy vegetable samosa, portioned for easy grazing between courses. Everything is fried fresh on the morning of delivery and packed in disposable trays with serving tongs. Delivery across Lagos Mainland, Ikeja included.

experiences.name: Arewa Native Poultry Express – Live Native Chickens
experiences.description: Proper Christmas native chicken from the North: 20 mature local-breed birds of 1.8 kg and above, free-ranging and firm-fleshed, ideal for stew. Chickens are bought at Kano-area markets and trucked live to Lagos, about 1,000 km over roughly two days, then delivered alive to your gate with legs tied by 23 December for slaughter at your home. Look each one over yourself on arrival. Pickup-truck delivery to Lagos Mainland addresses, Ikeja included.

experiences.name: Ota Farmstead Farm-Dressed Broilers
experiences.description: Christmas broilers straight from our farm: 20 whole birds, 1.8–2.3 kg each, ready for jollof, stew or frying. Birds are slaughtered and dressed by trained staff in our on-site processing unit and are not transported live off the farm. Processed 23 December, never frozen, packed whole in sealed bags with the weight printed on each, and delivered chilled at 0–4 °C in an insulated chiller van to Ikeja by 10 am on 24 December.

experiences.name: Zobo Junction Christmas Drinks & Fruit Package
experiences.description: Keep 60 guests refreshed through Christmas lunch: homemade zobo brewed from dried hibiscus with ginger and pineapple, party chapman, bottled water and platters of cut pineapple, watermelon, pawpaw and orange. Drinks arrive chilled in 20-litre dispensers with ice, cups included. Delivered to Ikeja on 24 or 25 December.
